description: The 'Known residual scope boundary' section (contracts/sprint-2.md:259-270, the LAST section of the document) still references a stale '35 targeted for closure' obligation count in two places, never updated when the sprint's actual target count was revised downward -- first in round 2 (resolves FIND-003/FIND-005) and again in round 4 (resolves FIND-009, which specifically moved PROP-303e out of the targeted set for being mis-scoped). Every OTHER section of the document that states this count has been correctly updated to '30' (CRIT-205's own text at lines 43/45: 'Every one of the 30 non-Tier-3 obligations', 'the 30 targeted PROP IDs'; the 'Deferred-obligation disposition' section's own heading at line 159/163: 'expected to promote 30 of the remaining 38... (revised from 35...)', '**30 targeted for closure this sprint**'), but the 'Known residual scope boundary' section was apparently never swept during either the round-2 or round-4 revision and still reads, verbatim: line 262, 'REQ-304's full multi-citizen sequential co-funding orchestration (two citizens' sequential transfers to the same child wallet, PROP-304b/c/d/f above) is included in the 35 targeted for closure...'; line 268, 'REQ-401/402/403's own remaining Tier-0/Tier-1 obligations not already proved by sprint-1 (see the 35-item list above) are targeted for real closure this sprint'. A reader relying on this section alone (the LAST section in the document, plausibly the one most likely to be read in isolation as a summary) would be told a count the rest of the contract has explicitly superseded twice over. This is the SAME class of documentation-staleness defect (a number/reference edited in one place but not swept to its sibling occurrences elsewhere in the same document) as the FIND-013 test-file-list gap this 3-round cycle has been fixing, just for a numeric figure instead of a file-name enumeration, and in a section none of rounds 2/4/6/7/8 appear to have re-swept.

evidence.lineRange: 262, 268 (Known residual scope boundary section, both still say '35') vs. 43, 45, 159, 163 (CRIT-205 + Deferred-obligation disposition heading, all correctly say '30')
evidence.snippet: grep -n '35' contracts/sprint-2.md -> lines 159 ('revised from 35, contract-review round 2...'), 198 ('The original 35-item list wrongly included PROP-203c/PROP-303f...' -- itself a historical/explanatory reference to the OLD figure, correctly framed as past-tense), 262 ('is included in the 35 targeted for closure'), 268 ('see the 35-item list above'). Lines 262/268 are the only two that state the CURRENT count in present tense as if it were still accurate -- both wrong, both should read '30'.
evidence.testName: grep -n '35' contracts/sprint-2.md, cross-referenced against grep -n '\\b30\\b' contracts/sprint-2.md (5 correct current-count occurrences at lines 43/45/159/163/166) to confirm 262/268 are the only two stale, present-tense-framed exceptions
